name: DevOps
seo_title: Hire Nearshore DevOps Engineers | TeamStation AI
meta_description: Hire elite nearshore DevOps engineers vetted by Axiom Cortex™ for secure CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and enhanced developer velocity. U.S. time-zones.
technical_analysis: We evaluate nearshore DevOps engineers on their ability to build secure, efficient, and automated software delivery pipelines. Candidates are tasked with creating a CI/CD pipeline for a containerized application from scratch. This requires writing a secure Dockerfile, using Terraform to provision necessary cloud infrastructure (like a container registry and a Kubernetes cluster), and configuring a CI tool to automatically build, test, scan for vulnerabilities, and deploy the application. We expect our nearshore DevOps engineers to implement GitOps principles for managing deployments. Success is measured by the pipeline's reliability, security posture (e.g., passing a Trivy scan), and the overall time from commit to production. This ensures the nearshore DevOps engineers you hire are true force-multipliers.
intro: DevOps engineers from TeamStation AI deliver production-grade systems with cognitive calibration and measurable performance.
